provenance.purpose: Original formal sampling then first DT/DataProto capture and Event hold before first update

prepared.weight_scope: Independent original VERL fresh actor, not live-weight bitwise replay; PEFT default B=0 and actual local B shards are checked before scoring; no update is called
prepared.numeric_scope: Original native logits dtype, original FP32 target log-softmax, original FP64 joint sums; differences are descriptive, no invented tolerance

no_update_scope: This independent actor has not loaded a checkpoint or called update_actor

causal_description.scope: Only descriptive p<=1 and causal ordering checks on original target values. Future means target predictor>=source, hence target token>source. No tolerance, clipping, correction, credit replacement, or acceptance gate

control_scope: The other three original rows are identical endpoint pairs; differences and factual drift are recorded without a new tolerance or correction
